You are an expert in analyzing logs of test execution script and dockerfile construction.  
Your task is to verify whether the target tests have been executed correctly and, if not, diagnose the issues.
Background: To run the target test files of a given repository, we create a Dockerfile and an eval script. We plan to invoke the eval script inside the container built by that Dockerfile.

You will:
1. Analyze the log of test execution to check if the target tests were executed and whether they passed.
2. If the tests did not run correctly, determine whether the issue is related to:
   - The **Dockerfile** (environment setup issues)
   - The **evaluation script** (test execution issues)
   - Missing information that needs to be collected

3. Based on your analysis, provide **clear guidance** to the appropriate agent:
   - `write_dockerfile_agent`
   - `write_eval_script_agent`
   - `context_retrieval_agent`

Your findings and recommendations must be structured in a JSON format, ensuring efficient collaboration with other agents.

Target repository name: crewAIInc/crewAI
Commit SHA: 4e496d7a202802917ad4f47eb9efdd6a41f06e18
Version: 0.119
Target test files:
tests/test_concurrency.py

The current dockerfile used to setup environemnt:
# Use a robust Ubuntu base with Bash and wide compatibility
FROM --platform=linux/x86_64 ubuntu:22.04

ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ENV TZ=Etc/UTC
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-c"]

# Install system dependencies, git, python3.11, build tools, curl, and Rust tooling (Rust needed for some builds)
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
       git \
       wget \
       curl \
       build-essential \
       python3.11 \
       python3.11-venv \
       python3.11-distutils \
       python3-pip \
       ca-certificates \
       locales \
       tzdata \
       rustc \
       cargo \
       gcc \
       g++ \
       unzip \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Ensure python3 points to python3.11
RUN update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/python3 python3 /usr/bin/python3.11 1

# Upgrade pip to the latest version
RUN python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip

# Set workdir
WORKDIR /testbed/

# Clone repo and check out the specified commit (4e496d7a202802917ad4f47eb9efdd6a41f06e18)
RUN git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI /testbed && \
    git fetch --depth=1 origin 4e496d7a202802917ad4f47eb9efdd6a41f06e18 && \
    git reset --hard 4e496d7a202802917ad4f47eb9efdd6a41f06e18 && \
    git remote remove origin

# Create and activate Python virtual environment named "testbed"
RUN python3 -m venv /testbed/venv

# Install core dependencies and develop mode repo with required extras [tools]
RUN source /testbed/venv/bin/activate && \
    pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip && \
    pip install --no-cache-dir crewai && \
    pip install --no-cache-dir "crewai[tools]" && \
    pip install --no-cache-dir -e . 

# Ensure bashrc activates virtual environment by default
RUN echo "source /testbed/venv/bin/activate" >> /root/.bashrc

ENV PATH="/testbed/venv/bin:$PATH"
ENV PYTHONPATH="/testbed/:$PYTHONPATH"

The current eval script (omit test patch to decrease length) used to run tests:
#!/bin/bash
set -uxo pipefail

cd /testbed
git checkout 4e496d7a202802917ad4f47eb9efdd6a41f06e18

# Apply test patch
git apply -v - <<'EOF_114329324912'
[CONTENT OF TEST PATCH]
EOF_114329324912

# Activate python virtual environment
source /testbed/venv/bin/activate

# Run only the target test file with uv command and pytest
# Use -rA to show all test summary info and --tb=short to keep tracebacks concise
uv run pytest -rA --tb=short tests/test_concurrency.py
rc=$?

echo "OMNIGRIL_EXIT_CODE=$rc"

git checkout 4e496d7a202802917ad4f47eb9efdd6a41f06e18 tests/test_concurrency.py
